association_and_sinkhorn_review.historical_scope: Nonnegative update allocation for actual parameter rows/columns; finite alternating scaling with residual measured. Not conservation of signed weights or exact finite-iteration marginal equality.
association_and_sinkhorn_review.double_budget_transfer_gap: Specified 2x2 nonnegative allocation and equal row/column budgets plus payoff maximum; current simplex vector and signed content are different objects. Need same-association endpoint semantics before selecting a balancing algorithm.
association_and_sinkhorn_review.delta_transfer_gap: Current contact update can change an already-correct weighted read and a read orthogonal to the standard write key, even with the same starting weighted content. Individual C_i innovation is not the aggregate key-read residual.
